params.prompt: The exact same jewel cavern, same wet mirror floor, same palette: but now the suspended prism has detonated in extreme slow motion, a silent bloom of glass and spectrum frozen mid-explosion; door-sized glass shards tumble outward end over end, each single shard trailing exactly one spectral color, one cyan, one violet, one magenta, one amber; dust hangs frozen in the god rays; a white-hot afterglow glows where the prism hung; deep amethyst shadow still dominates the cavern walls; dozens of large shards, not hundreds; phantom high-speed camera aesthetic, deep rich blacks, soft bloom; no text, no logos, no people
